changelog:
ClawSec Monitor assistant skill initial release:

- Provides `/clawsec` support for managing and interpreting ClawSec Monitor v3.0.
- Includes detailed detection pattern references for EXFIL and INJECTION threats.
- Documents all core proxy commands and usage workflow.
- Describes full HTTPS MITM setup and troubleshooting steps.
- Explains threat log format, deduplication, and file locations.
- Covers Docker deployment and configuration guidance.
- Outlines best practices for helping users interpret findings and resolve common issues.
summary: Intercept and inspect AI agent HTTP/HTTPS traffic with MITM proxy to detect and log exfiltration and injection threats in real time.
